About this study & handoff
All five scenes consume validated simulated context from the shared API. These are not live conditions. The original dashboard retains its compatible flood API. Scene appearance must never be used to infer whether a particular home is safe.
The approved artwork is the fixed visual base; rain, water, smoke and heat are separate animated overlays. The rabbit and foliage are currently still. One reusable scene accepts hazard and stage. Motion supports the stage label; it never replaces it. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Earthquake “Prepare” means general readiness, not a prediction. The event shake plays once and settles.
Review process: approve the still → review a short loop → compare all three stages → connect validated context data. Keep each stage readable without motion or color.
